answer_1.quote: ...our GET model can generate new types beyond the predefined type set for given entity mentions... we propose a novel generative entity typing (GET) paradigm: given a text with an entity mention, the multiple types ... are generated by a pre-trained language model (PLM).
answer_1.outputs: generated entity type strings (natural-language phrases) for each entity mention

answer_2.quote: ...we record the number of correct types assigned to the entity mentions (CT #) and strict macroaveraged precision (Prec.). ... we also record the average length of types (Len.)... we report Prec., R-Recall, R-F1...

answer_4.quote: ...annotators are invited to assess whether the generated types are correct. ...we invite annotators to evaluate the generated types and record the number of correct types.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators judge each generated type for an entity mention as correct or incorrect based on the context.
